svg.title: Monitor growth makes E smaller than every prescribed reference-coupling power after fixed block and stage choices. This is the rapidly decaying warning allowance used by the activity prices. A nonzero detector violates its quiet watch and supplies precisely such a coordinate within 2B. Thus simultaneous nonzero detector products lie in this joint event. The preceding plateau calculation proves the implication: under the quiet watch the curvature is at most one quarter of its threshold, the prediction mismatch is within its plateau, no nearby flag can occur, and every nonmandatory detector is a cutofftimes a vanishing plateau complement, while a mandatory detector is identically zero. Taking the contrapositive gives precisely the witness used in the probability bound. The lift retains covariance, address censuses and witness assignment maps; readout preserves their multiplicity bounds and the Gaussian moment-generating identity. The same joint estimate is recovered without selecting a new Gaussian for individual molecules.
